name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll Progress
description: A thin gradient bar along the top edge (purple, pink, peach) filling from left to right as the scene plays, like a reading progress bar.

moworks.author: magicui

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Scroll -> film time. progress: [[t, 0..1], ...] for uneven reading (linear between keys); else linear over duration. height 1 px as upstream; thicker reads better on video.
moworks.titleVi: Thanh tiến độ gradient ở mép trên
